shipped.title: Sentiment analysis
shipped.description: See whether the AI answers that mention you praise or criticize you, scored 0 to 100 against your competitors, with the passages behind it.

shipped.title: Position and competitive landscape
shipped.description: A new overview with visibility, share of voice, sentiment, and position cards, plus every competitor ranked by model.

shipped.title: Responses
shipped.description: Search every AI answer for your brand, filter by sentiment, and see where each company ranks in the answer.

shipped.title: MCP server and SDKs
shipped.description: Query and manage your visibility data from Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, or VS Code, or call the API from TypeScript and Python.

highlights.title: Site audits
highlights.description: Check whether AI crawlers can reach your site and whether your pages give engines something to cite.

highlights.title: Content simulator
highlights.description: Preview how AI responses will change before you publish — model the impact of new pages on your citations.

highlights.title: ChatGPT ads tracking
highlights.description: Monitor brand visibility in ChatGPT's sponsored placements as ads roll out across AI search.

highlights.title: Country and language tracking
highlights.description: Track prompts by market and language, then compare your AI visibility across countries and regions.
